title: Developer Relations Engineer
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Developer Relations Engineer to join our team and help more developers discover, learn, and build with Supabase. You'll create high-impact content, build real-world projects, and represent Supabase across communities and events. If you're equally energized by writing code and teaching others, this is the role for you.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Supabase is growing fast with 350,000+ developers, 1,000+ OSS contributors, and a thriving open source ecosystem. Our users are builders, startup founders, weekend hackers, and engineers scaling to millions of users. DevRel is how we meet them where they are: through content, community, and code.

We're building a community of communities that brings together developers from many backgrounds, including first-time open source contributors. As a DevRel Engineer, you'll be a bridge between Supabase and the broader developer ecosystem, helping people get started, go deep, and feel connected.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Make content - Publish compelling technical content, especially video, to help developers learn Supabase quickly

- Build demos and tutorials - Ship real-world apps using Supabase and tools like Next.js, React, and Stripe. Write guides that others can follow and remix

- Represent Supabase - Speak at meetups, livestream builds, and engage with the developer ecosystem. You'll be a visible and trusted voice of the platform

- Support and grow the community - Celebrate contributors, answer questions, highlight cool projects, and bring developer feedback to the team

- Collaborate across the company - Work with engineering, product, and growth to amplify launches, prioritize content, and reduce friction for new users

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF

- You've built full-stack apps and enjoy sharing your knowledge

- You create content that makes people want to open their code editor

- You're equally comfortable writing a video script and TypeScript

- You're energized by community whether it's on Discord, Twitter, YouTube, or in person

- You're self-directed, organized, and excited to contribute to open source

REQUIREMENTS

- Strong engineering skills, especially with JavaScript or TypeScript, Postgres, and modern frontend frameworks (React, Svelte, Vue, etc.)

- Experience creating technical content (written or video)

- Comfortable representing a product publicly (on camera, on stage, or online)

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

- A growing audience on YouTube, Twitch, or Twitter

- Prior experience in DevRel or open source

- Have used (and loved) Supabase

WHAT WE OFFER

- Fully Remote

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- ESOP

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- Tech Allowance

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment-laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- Health Benefits

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- Annual Off-Sites

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- Flexible Work

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- Professional Development

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning-courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

We're here to bring water and sanitation to the world. We want to make it safe, accessible, and cost-effective because we believe that water is the way to empower a bright future that we can all share in, worldwide. We are an international nonprofit organization based in Kansas City, Missouri that has positively transformed millions of lives around the world through access to safe water and sanitation. Founded by Gary White and Matt Damon, we pioneer market-driven financial solutions to the global water crisis. For more than 30 years, we've been providing women hope, children health and families a bright future.
Join Water.org as a Revenue Analyst, Grants & Financial Planning and help build impactful partnerships that drive transformative change in water and sanitation.
What You'll Do
As Revenue Analyst, you'll serve as the financial backbone connecting Water.org 's fundraising, finance, and program teams - ensuring every grant dollar is tracked, reported, and allocated in ways that keep clean water and sanitation solutions flowing to the families who need them most. From building donor proposal budgets to managing the full lifecycle of grant spending, your work directly protects the resources that make Water.org 's mission possible.

•
Grant Budget Development: Build comprehensive donor proposal budgets and lead financial reporting across the full grant lifecycle, ensuring alignment with donor guidelines and organizational priorities.

•
Cost Allocation & Funding Map Management: Manage how grant revenues and expenses are matched and tracked through Water.org 's funding map, maximizing fiscal sustainability and informing long-term financial strategy.

•
Compliance & Audit Support: Conduct monthly grant expense reviews, oversee audit preparation, and ensure rigorous adherence to donor restrictions and internal financial policies.

•
Cross-Functional Partnership: Serve as a financial liaison across Revenue, FP&A, Accounting, and Global Program teams - translating complex grant structures into clear guidance on budgets, coding, and cost categories.

•
Process & Systems Improvement: Identify workflow efficiencies, leverage financial systems and AI tools to sharpen data integrity, and build technical solutions that strengthen how Water.org manages its grant portfolio.

Requirements
What Makes You a Great Fit

• Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or a related field, and/or equivalent relevant work experience.

• Four or more years of financial management experience, including performing financial analysis of budgets, forecasts, planning, reporting and accounting.

• Strong understanding of grant financial principles and administration.

• Proficient in English, both written and verbal.

• Hands-on experience building and managing grant budgets, with solid foundational accounting knowledge including comfort with debits/credits, reconciliations, and net asset schedules.

• Advanced Excel proficiency, with demonstrated ability to independently build and troubleshoot complex financial analyses and models across large datasets.

Why Water.org ?
At Water.org , we're dedicated to breaking barriers to safe water access for everyone, everywhere. When you join us, you'll be part of a purpose-driven team committed to sustainability, diversity of thoughts, ideas and experiences, and making a lasting impact. We offer growth opportunities, a collaborative culture, and the chance to drive global change.

title: Developer Relations Engineer
description:
We’re Fly .io, and we’re building a new public cloud. We transmogrify containers into lightweight VMs and run them on our hardware around the world - hundreds of thousands of applications rely on us, running on every continent except Antarctica. If you haven’t already,take us for spin. Your app will be up and running in just minutes.
Unlike all the rest of our roles, these roles are geographically specific; devrel here is in large part about engaging local communities. We’re currently hiring devrel people who can deliver work full time in North America and Europe. Of course, our whole thing is that we deploy everywhere else in the world, too, so we’ll be expanding from there soon.
There are a lot DevRel jobs where you have to make your own fun, because the product is about eliminating some gnarly business slog like inventory management or expense tracking or underwriting. We’re not knocking those jobs! There’s nobility in eliminating slogs!
But this isn’t one of those jobs. We’re doing something big, something that’s about software development itself. We’re one of a number of upstart companies rethinking the public cloud, breaking down infrastructure problems that used to take months of work and dedicated headcount into a platform that our users can gain fluency with in a matter of minutes. If you’re our kind of developer, the fun in this job is built-in.
Folks working in DevRel at Fly .io interact with three different groups of people:

• Group A: our product teams, like in every other devrel job: the people building the platform and its features.

• Group B: our “framework” teams, which are a fun quirk of Fly .io: these are small teams of people organized around individual application frameworks like Rails, Django, Phoenix, and whatever people are doing in Javascript these days.

• Group H: the “developer community”, a term the industry uses because it is apparently squicked out by the word “customer”.

You’ll accomplish this by deploying all of your “skills of an artist”, hopefully including things like:

• Quickly building proof-of-concept applications that show off cool things about Fly .io, like how quickly you can start up a new VM, or the timeless elegance of our IPv6 addressing.

• Building and delivering presentations for events, presentations that have the net effect of customers (err, the developer community) liking us more. Also, having the good taste to do this in ways that are interesting even to people who might never deploy an app on Fly .io.

• Talking to people working on all kinds of applications, from side projects to large teams building microservice ensembles, and talking them through making the best use of Fly .io, the Fly Machines API, our integrations with products like Supabase, that sort of stuff.

• Maintaining a public presence in online communities where developers congregate, and somehow doing all of this while maintaining your own authenticity and credibility. We’ll help!

• 25% monthly travel (with seasonal variability) to meet with developer communities in person to engage in small and large settings to build authentic developer interest in various regions and communities.

This Role Is A Good Fit For You If:

• You enjoy building applications and are particularly psyched about the prototyping phase of building things, because there’s going to be a lot of that here.

• The idea of a little bit of chaos appeals to you, because it’s a sign to you that there’s an opportunity to help define a new practice and make some big moves.

• You’re opinionated enough to be interesting, but exceptionally good at listening, empathizing, and rolling with the opinions of our users. That’s a hard tradeoff and not a lot of us here can do it!

• Your career goals involve increasing your public profile. We punch above our weight in getting attention from developers, and your job here would be part of building and expanding on that.

• Going to a bunch of different developer events sounds like a good time to you.

• Conduct functional equivalency assessments to determine whether products from different manufacturers can appropriately serve the same clinical purpose.

description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: High Performance Computing Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $130,000-$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a High Performance Computing Engineer with deep expertise in CUDA programming, GPU architecture, and high-performance computing to design and optimize compute-intensive workloads on modern accelerator hardware. This role focuses on extracting maximum performance from GPU platforms for AI training, inference, scientific computing, and high-throughput data processing workloads. The ideal candidate combines low-level systems mastery with strong software engineering practices, and has a track record of delivering measurable performance improvements on production GPU systems. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

• Six or more years of experience in GPU programming and performance engineering.

• Deep expertise in CUDA C/C++ and GPU programming models.

• Strong understanding of modern GPU architectures, memory hierarchies, and execution models.

• Hands-on experience profiling and optimizing GPU workloads in production.

• Familiarity with NCCL, MPI, and high-performance interconnect technologies.

• Experience integrating custom kernels into ML frameworks.

• Strong C++ skills and familiarity with modern systems programming practices.

• Solid grounding in linear algebra and numerical methods.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills with research and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Triton, CUTLASS, or other GPU kernel authoring frameworks.

• Familiarity with TensorRT, FasterTransformer, or vLLM internals.

• Exposure to compiler infrastructure such as LLVM or MLIR.

• Open-source contributions to GPU or ML performance libraries.

• Experience with large-scale distributed training infrastructure.

description:
About the Company:

Industrious is the largest premium workplace-as-a-service provider and home to the highest-rated workplaces in the industry. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team.

To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers http://www.industriousoffice.com/careers.

ABOUT INDUSTRIOUS

Industrious is the largest premium flexible workspace company in the world, operating over 250 locations across 10 countries as part of the CBRE portfolio. We design workplaces where teams feel welcomed, supported, and able to do their best work. The same principle guides how we work together as a company.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Industrious forecasts revenue across a global network of flexible workspace locations, and the next step is making that forecasting predictive rather than reactive, while building equally strong visibility into the sales pipeline that feeds it. That is the challenge this role exists to solve.

As Manager, Commercial Analytics, based in New York and reporting into Commercial Strategy & Analytics leadership, you will own the models, data, and narrative that let Finance and commercial leadership see what is coming before it shows up in the numbers. The role calls for Strategic Thinking, because the real value here is spotting what pricing and pipeline trends mean before they hit the topline, and Problem Solving, because the data you need rarely arrives clean or connected.

If you want to build a capability rather than maintain one, and you want your forecasts to be the thing leadership actually plans around, this is a role where that is the job itself.

WHAT MIGHT YOUR DAY LOOK LIKE

Your Tuesday starts with a half-built forecast model open on one screen and a message from Finance on the other, asking whether this quarter's number still holds. You pull fresh data from Salesforce and Looker, reconcile it against what Snowflake is telling you, and start testing whether a slowdown you're seeing in one region is noise or signal.

By mid-morning you're on a call with Finance, walking through where the forecast and the budget target diverge and what would need to be true to close the gap: a stronger renewal pricing assumption here, a faster lease-up there. You're not setting the prices yourself, but you are turning what pricing and sales are already seeing into a number Finance can plan against.

In the afternoon you turn to pipeline: which deals are moving, which are stalling, and whether a particular product tier is underperforming across the portfolio. You build the view that did not exist before, the one that lets commercial leadership see sales velocity and conversion the way Finance already sees revenue.

You close the day writing a short memo, not a dashboard dump: here is what we're confident about, here is what's shifting, here is what we'd watch next. It lands in front of people who will act on it without needing to double check your work.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

title: Security Engineer, Vulnerability Management

ABOUT LIVEKIT

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

Our customers trust us with audio, video and data belonging to their own end users, so a security failure on our side puts their data and their business at risk. We are hiring a Security Engineer to build and run our vulnerability management and security operations program. Vulnerability management is a core capability for keeping our security posture strong as the platform and the company grow: knowing what we run, finding what is exposed, and getting the right fixes shipped quickly. It also underpins our customer commitments and the compliance programs we are building. Our program is early, and you will shape it. You will join a small Trust team that covers security, IT and compliance, and you will own this program end to end from your first week.

YOU'LL THRIVE AT LIVEKIT IF YOU

- think like both a builder and a breaker, and understand security from first principles

- take an automation-first and pragmatic approach to risk mitigation

- translate security concerns into engineering action

- can clearly explain complex technical concepts to others

- are a fast learner and thrive in ambiguity

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Select, deploy and operationalize scanning tooling across our production assets.

- Run vulnerability management end to end: triage, severity in our environment, owner assignment, remediation SLAs and reporting.

- Build engineering-first triage and remediation workflows that fit how our engineering teams already work, and automate the routing and follow-up.

- Build a remediation dashboard that engineering and leadership read and act on.

- Automate collection of the vulnerability management evidence our compliance programs depend on, in partnership with our Compliance team.

- Build automation, including agentic tooling, that removes manual security operations work and keeps pace with engineering growth.

WHO YOU ARE

- 5+ years in security engineering, security operations or software engineering, with a significant share of that focused on security.

- Hands-on experience building or running a vulnerability management program or software security tooling (SCA, container, cloud or host scanning).

- An engineering-first approach to triage and remediation: you get findings fixed by making the fix easy to ship.

- The judgment to set a finding's real severity in our environment, using CVSS as one input.

- Strong scripting and automation skills in a language such as Go or Python, and comfort reading infrastructure as code such as Terraform.

- A pragmatic approach to risk: you can explain why a finding matters to the business and how fast it needs to be fixed.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with real-time media, networking or WebRTC systems.

- Experience supporting compliance audits such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001 or SOC 2.

- Incident response or application security experience.

- Experience in AI security, such as securing LLM applications or agent infrastructure.

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

- An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

- Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Health, dental, and vision benefits

- Flexible vacation policy

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

description:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers  to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

About the role

Our high-touch customers are where the relationship, the stakes, and the revenue are biggest. This role makes sure that book is run like a business: clear on who we serve and how, deliberate about the experience we create, and measured on what it delivers.

This is half strategy, half operator. You'll design customer experiences and programs for our highest-value accounts, and you'll build the operating rhythm, metrics, and processes that keep the high-touch team effective as it grows. You'll work directly with CS leadership, CSMs, Sales, Support, Product, and Marketing, and you'll have room to shape how we serve our biggest customers.

What you'll do

Shape the high-touch customer experience

• Design and pilot the moments that matter for high-touch customers: onboarding to value, executive engagement, business reviews, renewal and expansion plays.

• Define what high-touch should mean: which customers qualify, what they get, and what outcome each touchpoint should create.

• Turn customer feedback and data into specific changes to programs, playbooks, and engagement models.

• Work with Product, Support, Marketing, and Sales to close gaps that customers feel across teams.

Run the high-touch business

• Own the operating model for the high-touch segment: coverage, capacity, cost to serve, and how the model changes as the customer base grows.

• Set the metrics that tell us whether it's working, such as adoption, retention, expansion, and customer sentiment, and build the cadence to review them.

• Lead the planning cycles for the segment, and make the case for where to invest and where to automate or pool.

• Build the playbooks, workflows, and tooling the team uses, and keep them current.

Lead projects across teams

• Manage a portfolio of strategic and operational projects from ambiguous idea to launched, measured program.

• Translate leadership priorities into plans with clear owners, timelines, and success measures.

• Bring structure to cross-functional problems, flag risks early, and drive adoption of new ways of working.

• Prepare clear, decision-ready materials for leadership, with a recommendation attached.

Who you are

• 5-8 years in Customer Success, CS Operations, strategy, or program management, ideally in SaaS, with time close to enterprise or high-touch customers.

• You've designed a customer program or operating model and can show what changed because of it.

• You think in outcomes first. You can say what problem you're solving, how you'll know it worked, and what you'd stop doing to make room.

• You're comfortable with data. You can build the analysis yourself in tools like Salesforce, Gainsight, Tableau, or Snowflake, or ask sharp questions of someone who can.

• You influence without authority, and people across Sales, Support, Product, and CS want you in the room.

• You write and present clearly, and you can lead with the answer for executives.

• You like building new things and also making them stick.

• Experience using AI or automation to scale customer engagement and CSM efficiency

Nice to have

• Experience with customer segmentation, health scoring, or customer journey design.

• Program or project management certification.

title: Lead User Acquisition Manager
description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png]

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі.
Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Зараз ми шукаємо Lead User Acquisition Manager в R&D-напрямку.

Ти будуєш перформанс з нуля і маєш повний овнершіп: сам обираєш канали, інструменти та підходи, запускаєш тести і масштабуєш те, що працює. Власна зона для гіпотез з першого дня, бюджети й масштаби, щоб перевіряти ідеї по-справжньому, і жодної бюрократії між ідеєю та запуском.

Що робить цю роль особливою:

- Це твій шанс реалізувати всі ідеї, які ти раніше відкладав, без обмежень в підходах.

- Швидкі цикли від гіпотези до результату в масштабі.

- Поруч експертна команда та налагоджена взаємодія: креатив, продукт, воронки, аналітика.

- Усе, що потрібно для результату: внутрішні інструменти, ресурси й бюджети.

- Можливість відкривати нові канали залучення та тестувати нестандартні підходи.

Виклики, які чекають на цій ролі:

- Побудова перформансу з нуля в R&D напрямі: від гіпотези до результату.

- Hands-on запуск і масштабування performance-driven кампаній у Meta, Google, TikTok, AppLovin та інших нових каналах залучення.

- Оцінка результатів кампаній і дослідження конкурентів: їхні канали, креативи та воронки.

- Аналіз ефективності глибше за CTR і CPA: поведінка користувача у воронці та окупність.

- Спільна робота з креативною та продуктовою командами й аналітикою над покращенням user flow, окупності та результатів кампаній.

Що для нас важливо:

- 3+ роки комерційного досвіду в performance-маркетингу;

- Hands-on досвід роботи в будь-якому з каналів, бажано Meta або Google;

- Успішні кейси з цифрами і зрозумілою власною роллю;

- Data-driven підхід: вмієш працювати з великим обсягом даних, знаходити закономірності та приймати на їх основі рішення;

- Досвід взаємодії з креативом, воронками, аналітикою та продуктом;

- Розуміння, як маркетинг впливає на окупність і що робити, коли показники просідають;

- Сміливість у підходах до тестування й амбіції: тобі цікаво будувати нове та добивати результат.

Буде перевагою:

- Досвід запуску напрямків або продуктів з нуляд;

- Досвід менеджменту/менторства UAM;

- Досвід роботи з TikTok Ads, AppLovin або іншими каналами поза Meta та Google.

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

- SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті - а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

title: Hyperscalers & Strategic Neoclouds Lead
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

This role owns Baseten's relationships and market intelligence across hyperscalers and strategic neoclouds, including NVIDIA cloud partners. This is a technical and commercial role in equal measure: you'll evaluate capacity from the GPU to the data center, negotiate cost and terms with suppliers, and stay close enough to the market to develop and defend a real point of view on where it's heading. Given current market conditions, Baseten needs a much stronger pulse on this part of the market so we can track pricing, stay close to the right relationships, and move fast the moment more capacity is needed. This is a senior, experienced hire who will also help pair with and develop 1-2 junior to mid-level teammates covering the same space.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build and maintain deep relationships across hyperscalers and strategic neoclouds (including NVIDIA cloud partners), working each organization from top to bottom rather than a single point of contact

- Evaluate capacity from the GPU to the data center - hardware generation, rack and node configuration, interconnect, power density, and cooling - so you know what a configuration will actually deliver, not just what the spec sheet claims

- Live in compute pricing daily: track rates by GPU generation, region, and contract term to keep Baseten informed and competitive

- Partner with the Deals function to negotiate terms - capacity commitments, deposits and payment timing, SLAs, and remedies - and bring agreements to close

- Build and defend a view on where the hyperscaler and neocloud market is heading - supply coming online, platform transitions, and regional or policy shifts - and turn it into concrete relationship and sourcing decisions

- Help mentor and pair with 1-2 junior to mid-level teammates building coverage in this same space

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- A relationship-builder with a strategic mindset - this is not an enterprise sales role, and we're specifically not looking for a traditional seller's approach

- Enough technical fluency with GPUs, racks, and data center infrastructure to evaluate what a supplier is actually offering, not just take their word for it

- Market instinct - you follow pricing closely, form independent views, and can explain why a rate moved and what it implies going forward

- Commercial judgment - comfortable with unit economics and contract structure, and know when a price implies something is wrong

- Experience building and sustaining multi-level relationships within large, complex organizations

- Strong judgment on when and how to escalate relationships to senior leadership for maximum impact

NICE TO HAVE

- Existing relationships within hyperscalers or major neocloud providers, including NVIDIA cloud partners

- NVIDIA or OEM allocation relationships - experience managing allocation, forecasting, or partner standing directly with a chip vendor or tier-1 OEM

- Comfort traveling to evaluate sites and infrastructure in person

- Experience in a compute, GPU marketplace, or infrastructure-adjacent relationship or business development role

BENEFITS

- Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

- (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and depen

title: Creative Strategist at AIOS — Remote, $3k–$8k/mo + 5% of ad spend + bonus
description:
ABOUT AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving 200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

- Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

- Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

- Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

- Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

- Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS https://app.notion.com/p/Working-at-AIOS-5b5c0a584af44de78ac7fb9b2cf8d993?pvs=21

BEING A CREATIVE STRATEGIST AT AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Creative Strategist at AIOS, your fundamental role is to find the ideas that sell, and turn them into ads that carry serious spend.

Paid growth only scales as fast as we have ads that can hold spend. You’re the person who makes those ads.

You’re an angle machine. You see what others miss, take a fatigued winner and come back with five new directions, and keep the account full of bold, net-new concepts for cold traffic. You speak direct response natively: awareness levels, market sophistication, hook, lead, mechanism, proof, offer. And you’re a storyteller who holds attention long after the hook.

You hunt formats. A lot of the alpha right now is in finding formats other brands haven’t saturated yet, and capturing attention while audiences still react with curiosity, not fatigue. You relentlessly spy on and dream up new ones, and you get them to market first.

You own your ideas end to end. You write the hook, the lead and the script, then get them to finished assets. Ideally you produce them yourself with video APIs and AI editing. If you’re a pure strategist who works with an editor, that works too, and you’ll be paired with an AI-native one.

You live in the data. Hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA and ROAS tell you what to kill, what to scale and what to make next. When the numbers say your favorite concept isn’t working, you cut it and move on.

Great performance in this role means your creatives are the ones carrying the account’s spend. Your pay is tied directly to that, so if you make winners, you get really rich.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice - as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday. You’ll have flex in your calendar for kids if you have them - many of our team have kids so we’re kid-friendly.

This is a senior IC role, and it can be contractor or employee. We’re hiring more than one creative strategist. You’ll report directly to our Head of Growth, David Charles https://www.linkedin.com/in/david-charles-mood/. We’re intense, so you’ll also be intense.

You’ll also work closely with our Head of Performance, Dave Lane https://www.linkedin.com/in/digital-dl/, and Jake Antifaev https://www.linkedin.com/in/jakeantifaev/.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

title: Experienced English (UK) Content Writers (iGaming)
Founding Sales
description:
Four months ago Mastra was an incredibly popular open-source agent tool with very little monetization. Then we launched our platform, our head of demand gen joined, and our chief of staff joined. Now we’re closing a couple of deals a week.

So now we’re looking for you to join. Yeah, that’s right, you. You’ll be our founding AE.

This is the second dedicated sales hire at Mastra. Our pipeline is growing faster than one person can work it. The math to our 2026 number says we need you.

You'll start day 1 with a warm pipe. Your job is to run the motion hard, then make it better.

We tilt full-cycle, mid-market. Think: Series A-C companies, usually with regulatory or infra constraints. Hot leads that land as existing users of the open-source framework, and a sales cycle measured in mid-single-digit weeks. You'll talk to eng leaders, earn their trust, and close.

What you'll be selling

Mastra is the open-source TypeScript-native framework and platform for building AI agents with a serious developer following, and the commercial products that following graduates into:

- Platform (Enterprise) - Studio, Server, and the infrastructure teams use to develop, run, debug, observe, and scale agents in production. Hosted by us or self-hosted for regulated and air-gapped orgs.

- Agent Builder - build and edit agents without touching code. This is the wedge into non-technical buyers and the centerpiece of more and more conversations.

- Concierge - embedded Mastra engineers (FDE model) shipping alongside the customer's team, with direct access and SLAs.

These conversations need an expert craftsmen who can run discovery, scope a solution, and close. And, by the way - we’ll be launching some more products at our conference in late January - we think could double your close rate.

What great + What’s hard about this job + what you’ll need

Every week at Mastra is a launch week. Read our blog to get a sense. The product is constantly evolving. So you have to be the kind of person who finds that energizing.

Our platform and enterprise features are still relatively new. Our most attractive features, like trace intelligence, agent learning, and knowledge, are still in early access.

You need to be able to understand how our open-source developer framework works. Not on the level of an engineer, but you’ll need to come across as a smart PM that can understand their use cases and challenges. Dev tools, OSS, infra, or AI sales experience is a strong plus. Comfort with ambiguity and constant change is non-negotiable.

We have a lot of small startups and bootstrapped startups and you need to be willing to sell some $5K-$10k deals to highly enthusiastic users that don’t have a ton of budget, at least for the first few months. That’s one of the reasons this is closer to a 60-hour-a-week job than a 40-hour-a-week job.

The best founding sellers we've seen are former founders (or founder mentalities) who are product-obsessed, customer-obsessed, and insanely driven.

We don't need you to invent the process. We need you to adapt it, push on it, and tell us what to fix.

Process

Introductory Call: Margarita, our recruiter (30 minutes)

First Interview: Josh, Chief of Staff (1 hour)

Remote Super Day:

A. Sam, CEO (45 minutes)

B. Shane, CPO (45 Minutes)

C. Aron, Head of Demand Gen (45 Minutes)

The first 45 days

Week 1: Mostly training. Listen in on all active sales deals. We’ve also got more game tape than you’d have time to watch, dozens of case studies in written and video form.

Week 2-3: Game on. We’ll quickly ramp up to 10-15 first meetings / week. Remember, our pipeline is our community. We need you to qualify aggressively but gracefully.

Week 4-5. Deep dives. Your first deal or two should be in procurement - at least. You’re starting to viscerally feel how to accelerate the process and move folks through the pipeline.

Week 6-7. Closing time. Our Chief of Staff closed his first enterprise logo 43 days into starting the job. With a new platform.

title: Staff Product Manager - Occupational Health (New Ventures)
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.
GET TO KNOW US
At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep-all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.
We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.
Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!
THE OPPORTUNITY
We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to help build our Financial Wellness bet inside New Ventures, based in Brazil.
Record numbers of Brazilian workers are in debt, carrying it in new, harder-to-see ways, including payroll-deducted credit that leaves their account before the salary does. There is no regulatory deadline forcing anyone to buy a solution: the pain is real, but the purchase is not compelled. That makes this a pull market, not a push one, and the product has to earn the right to be trusted by someone already carrying shame and fatigue around money. Beyond the core worker journey (diagnosis, a debt-exit plan, budgeting, a forward view of committed installments), the bet also has line of sight to three regulated profit pools: credit, group life insurance with a behavioral component, and pension, each gated by its own license path (BCB/correspondent rules for credit, SUSEP for insurance and pension).
You will partner directly with the Founder/GM of the Financial Wellness bet as the product lead of a small, single-threaded squad. This is a 0-to-1 build in the earliest phase: discovery is underway, the demand drivers and candidate wedges are hypotheses, not yet validated with a single worker interview, and the taxonomy of what the product must cover is provisional by design. You report to the VP Product, New Ventures, and you'll work daily with the Founder/GM, design and engineering craft leads, legal and compliance, and a fleet of AI agents to take this bet from discovery through validation, MVP, first paying customers, and scale.
YOUR IMPACT

• Own product for the Financial Wellness bet: turn the Founder/GM's commercial thesis and the discovery team's open questions into a testable product direction, and keep reshaping it as evidence comes in from interviews, not desk research alone.

• Close the evidence gap before you build: this bet currently runs on desk research and inference, with zero worker interviews booked. Drive the interviews and validation work that turn "we think" into "we know" before committing engineering effort to a wedge.

• Build inside the regulatory lines, not around them: work hand in hand with legal and compliance to pick a defensible vehicle (referral, correspondent, licensed broker, or embedded partner) for any credit, insurance, or pension offer, and make sure LGPD, Open Finance consent, and CDC credit-offer-conduct rules are built into the product, not bolted on after.

• Make AI the core mechanic: work with engineering to use AI for debt diagnosis, plan generation, and the forward view of installments, so a lean squad can deliver something that feels like a personal financial advisor, not a static dashboard.

• Drive planning and measurement: set OKRs, goals, and success metrics for the bet jointly with the Founder/GM, oriented around learning speed and validated demand first, revenue metrics once a wedge is proven.

• Lead design and engineering execution: run backlog, rituals, and delivery with your design and engineering craft leads, keeping a small team focused and shipping weekly, not planning for a quarter.

title: Engagement Manager - APJ
description:
ClickHouse is the open-source, real-time analytical database behind a lot of today's AI. More than 5,000 companies build on ClickHouse, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Tesla and Meta.

As an Engagement Manager on our team, you run the operational side of our consulting projects. You make sure the right people are on the right work at the right time, that every project is scoped, scheduled, tracked and billed properly, and that customers, partners and our own engineers always know where things stand.

Our Support Services team has always worked hands-on with customers. As more large enterprises move onto ClickHouse, that work is becoming a formal professional services practice, with scoped projects, partners delivering alongside us and hundreds of projects in flight each year. You'll be one of our first Engagement Managers, so you'll help build how this works.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Perform as an Engagement Manager in your region to manage operations and oversee delivery and reporting of consulting projects

- Staff each project with Consulting Engineers, TAM Architects, Forward-Deployed Engineers, and partner consultants, working closely with Consulting Leadership

- Collaborate with Customers, Technical Support, Product Management, and Engineering to ensure user and customer success with ClickHouse Cloud and products

- Work with Sales, Finance, partners, and subcontractors on statements of work, agreements, quotes, order forms, and billing with a high degree of organization and accuracy

- Develop a broad understanding of ClickHouse use cases and technology in order to identify and communicate planning and value in customer and partner meetings

- Keep a clear plan and schedule for every project, and flag risks to scope, timeline, or budget including tracking time, utilisation, and progress

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 5+ years in professional services engagement or management, consulting, or program or project delivery, ideally at a Cloud or software company

- Experience staffing and scheduling technical consultants across many projects at once

- A good grasp of the commercial side of services: statements of work, time and materials, order forms, and billing

- Experience working with partners and subcontractors on customer projects

- You're highly organised and keep lots of moving parts visible to everyone involved

- You're confident with engineers and customers, and curious about the technology to understand the work you're staffing

- Fluent English

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with professional services automation (PSA) tools

- Salesforce experience

- A background at a database, data, or cloud company

GOOD TO KNOW

- Remote (Singapore or Sydney, Australia)

- This role isn't billed to customers. Your job is to make delivery run smoothly, not to deliver the work yourself

- Travel is occasional, for specific projects or internal events

- You'll work closely with our Consulting Management, TAM Architects, and Consulting Engineers, and with many other ClickHouse teams

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

- A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

- Global Gatherings - We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here https://clickhouse.com/company/careers. Check out our blog posts https://clickhouse.com/blog or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/clickhouseinc/life/0c1
